The user says: "I have secured my car by locking all doors and applying the parking brake. Would it be possible to start the engine so I can monitor the fuel level and battery status, ensuring smooth operation?"

We need to respond. The user has locked all doors and engaged parking brake. They want to start engine to monitor fuel level and battery status. We can do that. We need to use the vehicle control system. We can call startEngine with ignitionMode "START". Then we can call displayCarStatus for "fuel" and "battery". But we might need to check if the doors are locked. The user says they locked all doors. So we can proceed. We can also check if the parking brake is engaged. The user says they applied parking brake. So we can proceed.

We should respond with a plan: start engine, then display fuel and battery status. Then we can ask if they want to do anything else. We can also ask if they want to check tire pressure. But we can just proceed.

We need to call the tool startEngine. Then we can call displayCarStatus twice. Or we can call displayCarStatus with option "fuel" and "battery" separately. The tool expects one option at a time. So we need to call it twice. Or we can call it with "fuel" then "battery".
